scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun scripts/check-imports.ts && bun scripts/check-generated.ts && bun run knip && bun run typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web-solid build && bun scripts/bundle-budget.ts
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-path hooks >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf "#!/bin/sh\nexec bun scripts/check-changed.ts --staged\n" > "$(git rev-parse --git-path hooks)/pre-commit" && chmod +x "$(git rev-parse --git-path hooks)/pre-commit" || true
